skill.name: git-pr-workflows-pr-enhance
skill.description: Creates structured pull request descriptions, review checklists, risk assessments, test coverage notes, and split recommendations for code review workflows.
skill.summary: Improves pull request readiness with review-focused descriptions, checklists, risk notes, and workflow guidance.

content.value_statement: Pull requests often lack clear context, risk notes, and review guidance. This skill turns change details into structured descriptions, checklists, and review aids.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes changed files and change statistics from Git diff context.
Builds pull request descriptions with summary, testing, risk, and dependency sections.
Creates review checklists based on file categories and likely change impact.
Flags large pull requests and suggests logical split plans.
Drafts coverage, architecture, and risk report sections for reviewers.
Provides reusable templates for features, bug fixes, refactors, and review replies.
limitations: Requires accurate Git diff, commit, or coverage inputs from the user or local tools.
Does not guarantee that generated risk scores match project-specific release policies.
Cannot verify tests, coverage, or deployment status without supporting evidence.
Generated templates still require human review before posting to a repository.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feature PR
use_cases.description: Turn a feature branch into a clear pull request with scope, tests, risks, and reviewer context.

use_cases.title: Improve Review Readiness
use_cases.description: Add checklist items, risk notes, and split suggestions before requesting review on a complex change.

use_cases.title: Standardize Repository PRs
use_cases.description: Create consistent PR templates and response language for teams that review many changes each week.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a PR Description
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with supplied change context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PR description for my current change. Use this context: [summary], [changed files], [tests], and [risks].

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request draft and improve it for reviewers. Add missing sections, clearer testing notes, and a concise checklist: [draft].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Review Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using a diff summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Git diff summary and propose review risks, impacted areas, split opportunities, and suggested reviewer focus areas: [diff summary].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full PR Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complex refactor or migration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete PR package for a large refactor. Include an executive summary, change categories, migration notes, coverage discussion, risk mitigation, and reviewer response templates. Context: [details].

output_examples.input: A branch adds a cache layer and changes API routing.
output_examples.output: A reviewer-ready PR summary with scope, architectural impact, tests run, risk level, and follow-up items.

output_examples.input: A pull request changes 35 files across API, UI, and tests.
output_examples.output: A split recommendation grouping API changes, UI changes, and test updates into smaller review units.

output_examples.input: A bug fix PR lacks a testing section.
output_examples.output: A revised bug fix description with root cause, verification steps, regression checks, and reviewer checklist items.

best_practices: Provide the branch base, changed files, test results, and known risks before asking for a full PR package.
Review generated checklists against your team's merge policy before posting them.
Use split recommendations early, before reviewers invest time in a very large pull request.
anti_patterns: Do not paste generated PR text without confirming tests, screenshots, and deployment details.
Do not use generic risk labels when the change touches security, data, or migrations.
Do not ask for automation output without supplying the diff or a reliable change summary.

faq.question: Does this skill open pull requests for me?
faq.answer: No. It helps draft and organize PR content, but repository actions still require user-controlled tools.

faq.question: Can it analyze any language?
faq.answer: Yes, if the change summary is clear. Some examples focus on common source, test, config, and documentation files.

faq.question: Does it require Git access?
faq.answer: Git access helps for diff and statistics analysis. Users can also paste summaries, file lists, and test results.

faq.question: Can it create test coverage reports?
faq.answer: It can format and explain coverage information. It needs real coverage data from your project tools.

faq.question: Will it find every security issue?
faq.answer: No. It offers review prompts and risk notes, not a substitute for security testing or code review.

faq.question: Is it suitable for large refactors?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize scope, suggest splits, and create reviewer guidance for large changes.
